summary: Full frontend E2E testing of Knowledge Vault SaaS dashboard. All 13 requested features verified end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL. No backend involved. No console errors detected during runs.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: 'All' category count in sidebar (5) excludes Archive items while 'items stored' shows total (6). This is intentional (Archive is a bucket) but may confuse users; consider a tooltip or label 'All (active)'.

Minor: categories memo hard-codes BUILTIN_CATEGORIES.slice(0,3) plus 'Archive' at end — fragile if BUILTIN_CATEGORIES is reordered. Prefer explicit ['Credentials','Notes','Links'] and appending 'Archive' explicitly.
Nit: window.prompt/alert used for New Category — works but not accessible/styled consistently with the app's modals.
seed_data_creation: App auto-seeds 6 items on first load (fresh localStorage). 'All' filter excludes Archive so shows 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only React app. Preview URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Use page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) for Copy tests. Register a page.once('dialog', ...) handler BEFORE clicking new-category-btn since it uses window.prompt. LocalStorage keys: vault-items, vault-categories, vault-theme. All data-testid attributes present and stable.
